plan.notes: Transcribed from the official 2025-2026 LATTC General Catalog (lattc.edu). Semester sequences, course codes, titles, and unit values transcribed exactly as published. The catalog does not state course prerequisites for these sequences. Certificate: 24 units, all sequenced.

courses.title: Heavy Duty Maintenance Shop Practices, Engine Fundamentals, and Electrical Systems
courses.choice_note: Catalog offers alternative: DIESLTK 112A Heavy Duty Maintenance Shop Practices (4) + DIESLTK 112B Heavy Duty Engine Fundamentals (4) + DIESLTK 112C Heavy Duty Electrical Systems (4) instead of the single 12-unit course.
